recap.title: Whitlock’s late strike snatches a 2-2 draw for Harlow Cross
recap.summary: Harlow Cross rescued a 2-2 draw in stoppage time after a rollercoaster where advantage kept switching hands. At 41' Hartsell’s red card left Marsh Dock United down to ten and nudged Harlow Cross’ win chance from 36% to 49%, shifting the momentum. At 55' Oddie’s strike made it 0-2 and pushed Marsh Dock United’s win probability from 59% to 88%, seemingly closing the contest. Then at 90+1' Whitlock’s late finish made it 2-2 and collapsed Marsh Dock United’s win chance from 91% to 2%, vaulting the draw to 89%. Bellweather was the standout: they produced a 0.76 xG chance at 15' and set up Okonkwo-Reid’s 66' goal, finishing the game as the top-rated performer with a 9.2. What the numbers say: Harlow Cross led the counting stats with 2.43 xG, 16 shots and 63% possession to Marsh Dock United’s 0.73 xG, 9 shots and 37%; at full time (90+8') the match finished 2-2 with win probabilities at 0% / 100% / 0% for home/draw/away.
